examples.title: Displaying a Prompt
examples.explanation: Using fmt.Print outputs the prompt string to standard output without adding a trailing newline, keeping the cursor on the same line.

examples.title: Reading Input with a Buffer
examples.explanation: bufio.NewReader wraps os.Stdin to provide efficient buffered reading, and ReadString('\n') reads until the newline character.

examples.title: Handling Exit and EOF
examples.explanation: Checking for io.EOF or matching the 'exit' command allows the loop to break or terminate the process cleanly using os.Exit.
